purpose: Canonical publication registry for btisler-DS/constraint-ethics-necessity. Single source of truth for DOI, title, document type, and version relationships across project papers. Generated 2026-06-05 from cross-checking the original public-facing list against the Zenodo records API and the repo README.

status_field_semantics.comment: These four status dimensions are deliberately separate. Do not collapse them into one field.

zenodo_formal_status.description: What Zenodo's own metadata says about this record's availability.

version_status.description: Zenodo-formal versioning status, derived from whether multiple records share a single Zenodo concept record. 'current_version' = is_last:true on a concept record with >1 version. 'previous_version' = an earlier version on the same concept record. 'only_version' = the concept record has just one version (the default; applies even for paired-but-Zenodo-independent records like the P4/P5 April-9 and May-20 results, which sit on separate concept records).

repo_canonical.description: True if the repo README cites this record as the current external-facing citation for its protocol/paper. False for earlier or alternate records that the README does not cite as current. May be null when the README does not take a position.

external_citation_status.description: How the project recommends citing this record externally. 'cite_this' = preferred for new external citations. 'historical' = earlier related record, remains discoverable, not the preferred external citation. 'do_not_cite' = withdrawn/410 or otherwise broken; must not appear in new citations. 'undetermined' = pending editorial decision.
